name: GrL'Ca Search for WooCommerce
author: GrL'Ca

sections.description:
GrL’Ca Search for WooCommerce enhances your WooCommerce store with advanced search capabilities:

Key Features

  • Autocomplete search suggestions as you type
  • Product images and prices in search results
  • Category suggestions
  • Keyboard navigation support
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Easy shortcode implementation
  • Automatic WooCommerce search form enhancement
  • Secure with nonce verification

The plugin automatically enhances existing WooCommerce search forms and provides a shortcode for custom placement.

How It Works

  1. Automatically enhances all WooCommerce search forms
  2. Provides live search suggestions with product images and prices
  3. Includes category results with product counts
  4. Supports keyboard navigation (up/down arrows, enter, escape)
  5. Mobile-optimized interface
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin activated

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “GrL’Ca Search for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/grlca-search-for-woocommerce directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. The plugin will automatically enhance existing search forms

Using the Plugin

  • Existing WooCommerce search forms are automatically enhanced
  • Use shortcode [grlca_search] in posts, pages, or widgets
  • Customize with [grlca_search placeholder="Your text"]
sections.faq:
How do I use the search shortcode?

Use [grlca_search] in any post, page, or widget area.

Can I customize the placeholder text?

Yes, use [grlca_search placeholder="Your custom text"]

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce.

What are the system requirements?

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • WooCommerce plugin

Can I style the search results?

Yes, you can override the CSS styles in your theme’s stylesheet.
